changeSet.author: tgms
changeSet.comment: Replace the Inventory fake-delete DISCONTINUED state with normal CRUD deletion while retaining ACTIVE and INACTIVE as operational stock-availability states. This destructive legacy cleanup is forward-only and intentionally has no rollback because deleted or converted data cannot be reconstructed.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM inventory_materials WHERE status = 'DISCONTINUED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM production_task_material_requirements r WHERE r.inventory_material_id = inventory_materials.id )
ALTER TABLE inventory_materials DROP CHECK ck_inventory_materials_status
ALTER TABLE inventory_materials DROP CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_materials_status
ALTER TABLE inventory_materials ADD CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_materials_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
